title: solanum marinum
intro: Solanum marinum, commonly known as Sea Box or Seaside Forsythia, is a perennial plant in the nightshade family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with its reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents present in Solanum marinum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
